correctness.rationale: Odd-characteristic discriminant normalization is bijective. In characteristic two, two independent trace hyperplanes yield q(q−2)/4; in characteristic three the three-sign moment and zero-line corrections give (q−1)(q−3)/8. In characteristic at least five, singleton/double moments vanish, every triple is q, quadruple is q−U via a single exceptional quadratic discriminant, and explicit line and pair corrections yield the exact formula. The three cubic polynomials are squarefree, so Hasse gives positivity q≥11; q=2,3,5 vanish and q=7 has explicit witness. An independent root-existence verifier checked 258 distinct shift cases. Finite tests corroborate, not replace, proof.
